name: Japanese absorption original acceptance after saved real turn

condition.code: return Game.GetLocalPlayer()>=0 and Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:IsTurnActive() and ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption~=nil and ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroLifespanKey~=nil and ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI~=nil

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay);local R=A.Rules
A.RegisterUnitProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_BELONGINGS')
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1'));local plan=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_PLAN_V1')
local nativeDefinition
for _,row in ipairs(Game.GetReligion():GetReligions()) do if row.Religion==e.Religion then nativeDefinition={Religion=row.Religion,Founder=row.Founder,Beliefs=R.Copy(row.Beliefs or {})} end end
assert(nativeDefinition and nativeDefinition.Founder==e.From,'native religion identity/founder lost')
local tx=A.GetState().Transactions[plan.ID];assert(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()>tx.Turn,'AI turn did not advance')
assert(Players[e.From]:GetCities():GetCount()==0 and Players[e.From]:GetUnits():GetCount()==0,'donor regained an engine asset')
assert(next(A.GetRoster(e.From))==nil,'donor roster regained an asset')
local control=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_CONTROL_PRIEST_V1');local controlAlive=false;if control then for _,u in Players[control.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetID()==control.ID then controlAlive=true end end end
if control then print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AUDIT] control owner='..control.Owner..' unit='..control.ID..' alive='..tostring(controlAlive)) end
local transferred=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_TRANSFERRED_V1'),'no immediate invariants')
local capturedState=A.GetState();capturedState.SourceReadSerial=nil
local actual={State=capturedState,Roster=A.GetRoster(e.To),Units={},Cities={},Plots={}}
for id,expected in pairs(transferred.Roster) do
 local record=assert(actual.Roster[id],'persistent asset lost after AI turn: '..id)
 assert(record.Owner==e.To and record.ID==id,'persistent asset ownership after AI turn: '..id)
 assert(A.Canonical(record)==A.Canonical(expected),'persistent asset changed after AI turn: '..id)
end
-- Religious units were verified exactly at transfer and immediate reload.
-- The AI may consume or remove them on its own turn; do not assert survival.
actual.ReligiousUnits={}
for _,u in Players[e.To]:GetUnits():Members() do
 local snap=A.SnapshotUnit(u)
 if snap.Religion>=0 or (snap.SpreadCharges or 0)>0 then actual.ReligiousUnits[#actual.ReligiousUnits+1]=snap end
end
table.sort(actual.ReligiousUnits,function(a,b) return a.ID<b.ID end)
for _,old in ipairs(e.Units) do
 if old.Religion<0 and (old.SpreadCharges or 0)<=0 then
 local u=assert(A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':unit:'..old.ID),'transferred unit lost after AI turn: old='..old.ID..' type='..old.Type..' untransferred_control_alive='..tostring(controlAlive))
 assert(u:GetOwner()==e.To and GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType==old.Type,'unit owner/type after AI turn')
 local gp=u:GetGreatPerson();assert((gp and gp:GetIndividual() or -1)==old.Individual,'native general identity after AI turn')
 local snap=A.SnapshotUnit(u)
 if old.Hero then
  assert(snap.Hero and snap.Hero.Class==old.Hero.Class and snap.Hero.ClassType==old.Hero.ClassType,'native Hero identity after AI turn')
  assert(snap.Hero.Origin.Owner==e.To and snap.Hero.Origin.X==old.Hero.Origin.X and snap.Hero.Origin.Y==old.Hero.Origin.Y,'native recall origin after AI turn')
  assert(snap.Hero.Lifespan==old.Hero.Lifespan-(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-tx.Turn),'native lifespan did not consume exactly the elapsed turns')
  assert(snap.Hero.RenownUnavailable==old.Hero.RenownUnavailable,'native renown capability changed after AI turn')
 end
 assert(A.Canonical(snap.Properties)==A.Canonical(transferred.Properties[tostring(old.ID)]),'transferred unit properties changed after AI turn: '..old.ID)
 actual.Units[#actual.Units+1]=snap
 end
end
actual.Leader=A.SnapshotUnit(assert(A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':leader')))
assert(A.Canonical(actual.Leader.Properties)==A.Canonical(transferred.Properties.leader),'leader properties changed after AI turn')
for _,old in ipairs(e.Cities) do local c=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(old.X,old.Y));assert(c:GetOwner()==e.To,'city owner after AI turn');actual.Cities[#actual.Cities+1]={Owner=c:GetOwner(),Name=c:GetName(),Population=c:GetPopulation(),Faith=A.CityReligion(c),Assets=A.CityAssets(c),Governance=c:GetProperty(R.GOVERNANCE_KEY),FaithProperty=c:GetProperty(R.CITY_FAITH_KEY)} end
for _,old in ipairs(e.Cities) do for _,work in ipairs(old.PalaceWorks) do assert(A.OwnedGreatWorks(e.To)[work],'Palace work lost after AI turn') end end
for _,i in ipairs(e.Plots) do local owner=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i):GetOwner();assert(owner==e.To,'old territory lost after AI turn');actual.Plots[i]=owner end
assert(actual.Roster['live:hero'].Lifespan==19 and actual.Roster['live:religion'].Founder==e.From,'persistent Hero/religion data changed')
actual.NativeDefinition=nativeDefinition
return A.Canonical(actual)

local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption)
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1'))
local death=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1')
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE={Phase='LIVING',Owner=e.To,Targets={},Results={}}
local probe=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE
for _,old in ipairs(e.Units) do if old.Hero and (probe.Phase=='LIVING' or old.Hero.Class==death.Class) then
 probe.Targets[#probe.Targets+1]={Class=old.Hero.Class,X=old.Hero.Origin.X,Y=old.Hero.Origin.Y}
end end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE_HANDLER then Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE_HANDLER) end
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE_HANDLER=function()
 if probe.Complete or probe.Error or not Players[probe.Owner]:IsTurnActive() then return end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local localPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
  assert(localPlayer<0 or localPlayer==probe.Owner,'AI probe still uses another human command context')
  assert(not Players[1]:IsTurnActive() and not Players[probe.Owner]:IsHuman(),'AI probe changed controller or turn')
  local manager=Game.GetHeroesManager()
  for _,target in ipairs(probe.Targets) do
   local origin=assert(manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(target.Class))
   assert(manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(target.Class)==probe.Owner and origin.player==probe.Owner,'recall claim/owner changed')
   local city=assert(Players[probe.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   assert(city:GetX()==target.X and city:GetY()==target.Y,'recall origin changed')
   local building=manager:GetPlayerHeroOriginBuildingType(probe.Owner,target.Class)
   assert(type(building)=='number' and building>=0 and city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(building),'native recall origin building missing')
   local native=GameInfo.Units[GameInfo.HeroClasses[target.Class].UnitType]
   local params={[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_UNIT_TYPE]=native.Hash,[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_YIELD_TYPE]=GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index}
   local visible=CityManager.CanStartCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,true,params,false)
   local allowed,results=CityManager.CanStartCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,false,params,true)
   local alive=0;for _,u in Players[probe.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetHeroClassType()==target.Class then alive=alive+1 end end
   local cost=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION)
   probe.Results[#probe.Results+1]={Class=target.Class,Claim=manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(target.Class),Origin=origin,
    LocalPlayer=localPlayer,OwnerActive=true,IsHuman=false,Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),Era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),
    Alive=alive,OriginBuilding=building,Visible=visible,Allowed=allowed,Results=results,Cost=cost,Faith=Players[probe.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()}
  end
  probe.Complete=true
  print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE] '..A.Canonical(probe))
 end)
 if not ok then probe.Error=tostring(err) end
end
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE_HANDLER)
return 'strict recall probe prepared for actual AI owner turn; phase='..probe.Phase

local p=assert(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE)
assert(not p.Error,p.Error);assert(p.Complete,'AI active-turn probe never ran')
assert(p.Phase=='LIVING' and #p.Results==2,'native recall probe coverage changed')
for _,r in ipairs(p.Results) do
 assert(r.OwnerActive and not r.IsHuman and (r.LocalPlayer<0 or r.LocalPlayer==p.Owner),'invalid AI recall query context')
 assert(r.Cost>0 and r.Faith>=r.Cost,'recall rejection could be insufficient faith')
 assert(not r.Allowed,'native recall ignored living Hero')
 assert(r.Alive==1,'living recall fixture missing')
end
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE_HANDLER)
return ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption.Canonical(p)

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay);local e=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1')
local m=assert(A.GetHeroesManager());local class=GameInfo.HeroClasses['HEROCLASS_JAC_WARLORD_A'].Index
local record=assert(A.GetRoster(e.To)['live:hero']);local u=assert(A.FindUnit(e.To,record.Unit.Token))
assert(u:IsHero() and u:GetHeroClassType()==class,'recall death fixture is not a native hero')
local origin=m:GetHeroOriginCityID(class);local city=assert(Players[e.To]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1',{Owner=e.To,EraBefore=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),Class=class,CityID=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Record=A.Canonical(record)})
UnitManager.Kill(u)
Players[e.To]:GetReligion():ChangeFaithBalance(1000000)
assert(m:GetHeroClaimPlayer(class)==e.To,'native death lost absorber recall rights')
assert(A.Canonical(A.GetRoster(e.To)['live:hero'])==Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1').Record,'death lost contract/loyalty/relations')
return 'native Warlord A retired for engine recall eligibility probe; faith funded'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay);local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1'))
local origin=assert(A.GetHeroesManager():GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class))
local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
local class=assert(GameInfo.Units[GameInfo.HeroClasses[e.Class].UnitType].FormationClass)
local blockers={}
for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 if u:GetX()==city:GetX() and u:GetY()==city:GetY() and GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].FormationClass==class then blockers[#blockers+1]=u end
end
table.sort(blockers,function(a,b) return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
for _,u in ipairs(blockers) do
 local placed=false;local damage=u:GetDamage();local moves=u:GetMovesRemaining()
 for x=city:GetX()-6,city:GetX()+6 do
  for y=city:GetY()-6,city:GetY()+6 do
   local plot=Map.GetPlot(x,y)
   if not placed and plot and plot:GetOwner()==e.Owner and not plot:IsWater() and not plot:IsImpassable() and (x~=city:GetX() or y~=city:GetY()) then
    local units=Map.GetUnitsAt(plot)
    if not units or units:GetCount()==0 then
     UnitManager.PlaceUnit(u,x,y)
     if u:GetX()==x and u:GetY()==y then u:SetDamage(damage);u:ChangeMovesRemaining(moves-u:GetMovesRemaining());placed=true end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 assert(placed,'no empty owned plot for recall spawn blocker '..u:GetID())
end
return 'recall spawn blockers relocated without deletion: '..#blockers

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1'))
assert(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()>e.EraBefore,'global era boundary not processed')
local alive={}
for _,unit in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 if unit.IsHero and unit:IsHero() and unit:GetHeroClassType()==e.Class then
  local person=unit:GetProperty(A.Rules.PERSON_KEY)
  assert(not person or person.ID=='live:hero','same Hero class belongs to another person')
  alive[#alive+1]=unit
 end
end
assert(#alive<=1,'ambiguous AI Hero instances after era wait')
for _,unit in ipairs(alive) do UnitManager.Kill(unit) end
for _,unit in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 assert(not unit.IsHero or not unit:IsHero() or unit:GetHeroClassType()~=e.Class,
  'controlled Hero remains alive before official recall')
end
print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_POST_ERA_HERO_RETIRED] count='..#alive)
A.BeginHeroRecall('japan-ai-recall:1','japan-live-absorption','live:hero')
return 'actual AI recall intent saved before the owner turn'

local api=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption)
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1'))
local manager=Game.GetHeroesManager()
local def=GameInfo.HeroClasses[e.Class]
local native=GameInfo.Units[def.UnitType]
local params={[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_UNIT_TYPE]=native.Hash,
 [CityCommandTypes.PARAM_MILITARY_FORMATION_TYPE]=MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION,
 [CityCommandTypes.PARAM_YIELD_TYPE]=GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index}
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE={Owner=e.Owner,Class=e.Class,OriginBefore=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class),Existing={},Trace={},FaithChanges={},Purchases={},Spawns={}}
for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE.Existing[u:GetID()]=true end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER then Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER) end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER then Events.FaithChanged.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER) end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER then Events.CityCommandStarted.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER) end
if JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER then Events.UnitAddedToMap.Remove(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER) end
local function trace(kind,entry)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 entry.Kind=kind;entry.Order=#p.Trace+1;p.Trace[#p.Trace+1]=entry
end
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER=function(owner,yield,balance)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if owner~=e.Owner or not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 trace('FAITH',{Owner=owner,Yield=yield,Balance=balance})
 if balance~=p.LastFaith then p.FaithChanges[#p.FaithChanges+1]={Before=p.LastFaith,After=balance};p.LastFaith=balance end
end
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER=function(owner,city,districtOwner,district,command,data)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if owner~=e.Owner or not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 trace('COMMAND',{Owner=owner,City=city,Command=command,Data=data})
 if command==CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE then p.Purchases[#p.Purchases+1]={City=city,Command=command,Data=data} end
end
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER=function(owner,id,x,y)
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if owner~=e.Owner or not p.Requested or p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 local class=-1;for _,u in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetID()==id then class=u:GetHeroClassType() end end
 trace('UNIT',{Owner=owner,ID=id,Class=class,X=x,Y=y})
 p.Spawns[#p.Spawns+1]={ID=id,Class=class,X=x,Y=y}
end
Events.FaithChanged.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_FAITH_HANDLER)
Events.CityCommandStarted.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_COMMAND_HANDLER)
Events.UnitAddedToMap.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_UNIT_HANDLER)
JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER=function()
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  if not p.Requested then
   if not Players[e.Owner]:IsTurnActive() then return end
   assert(not Players[e.Owner]:IsHuman() and not Players[1]:IsTurnActive(),'AI recall changed controller/turn')
   assert(Game.GetLocalPlayer()<0 or Game.GetLocalPlayer()==e.Owner,'another human command context')
   assert(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()>e.EraBefore,'global era boundary not processed')
   local origin=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class)
   assert(manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(e.Class)==e.Owner and origin.player==e.Owner and origin.id==e.CityID,'AI recall claim/origin changed')
   local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   p.OriginX=city:GetX();p.OriginY=city:GetY()
   local allowed,results=CityManager.CanStartCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,false,params,true)
   p.Query={OwnerActive=true,LocalPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer(),IsHuman=Players[e.Owner]:IsHuman(),Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),Era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),Allowed=allowed,Results=results}
   assert(allowed,'native recall not allowed on actual owner turn')
   p.CostBefore=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION)
   p.FaithBefore=Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()
   p.LastFaith=p.FaithBefore
   assert(p.CostBefore>0 and p.FaithBefore>=p.CostBefore,'native AI recall cost/faith invalid')
   p.Requested=true
   trace('REQUEST',{Owner=e.Owner,City=origin.id,Class=e.Class,Cost=p.CostBefore,Faith=p.FaithBefore})
   CityManager.RequestCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,params)
   print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_REQUEST] '..api.Canonical(p))
   return
  end
  for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if u:GetHeroClassType()==e.Class and not p.Existing[u:GetID()] then
    assert(not p.NewID,'multiple native recall candidates')
    p.NewID=u:GetID()
   end
  end

   local origin=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class)
   local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   p.FaithAfter=Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()

   p.Complete=true
   print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_COMPLETE] '..api.Canonical(p))
  end
 end)
 if not ok then p.Error=tostring(err);print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_ERROR] '..p.Error) end
